summary: A mixed day balancing significant legal developments with retail sector shifts and regulatory changes. Key themes include judicial governance concerns, food labeling policy reversal, and continued FDI momentum.

bullets.text: SC Justice seeks replacement of Rajasthan HC Acting Chief Justice for office misuse; governance integrity concern.
Food regulator drops planned red-flag nutrition warnings on chips, soda after industry opposition.
SC rules crime victims have right to speedy trial; murder cases need not freeze under Gangsters Act.
Gross FDI climbs significantly; net inflows turn positive, signaling improved investor confidence.
Inorbit Malls acquires Prozone properties in Coimbatore and Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar; expansion accelerates.
